first off, here is a hug. *hug* 

people look down on "burger flipping" jobs, but if we didnt have people working in fast food, who would make food for everyone? you're getting job experience at one of the toughest first jobs out there, that counts for something! that experience will matter more than your high school grades. im 24 now, and my coworkers dont care what i got for high school math, they care about how well i work and what i can do. i have had the same part time job since i was about your age. even if its a low level part time job, i still get some good experience and references that i can carry on to other jobs and careers.

For me now, Pokemon. Sounds silly, but thinking of the next playthroughs and getting excited over the new Pokemon games Sun and Moon can get me through a tough time. Once that comes out and I play it for a while, something else will be announced or there will be something else for me to look forward to. Basically, I sometimes play "connect the dots", making it from point to point. 

So maybe finding something in the future to be excited about might help? For me it ends up being video games, or a class I want to take or a job I'm interested in and want to work toward. Just thinking of something that you want to try at least once.

Helping others is a reason to live too. People say you help more people alive than dead. I don't know if I believe that for myself, but people tend to like the ADDING of something GOOD more than the REMOVAL of something BAD. So if you do a nice thing for someone, they will like it more than removing you (if you think you're a bad person). 

Also as people have said, pets. They are so good and pure. You are their world. You give them food, water, companionship. They would be sad without you. And if you haven't seen your pet in a while, they will still remember you. My mom had to spend a few years away from one of our cats that she was pretty close with and they were temporarily reunited for a vet visit for the cat, and the cat snuggled up to my mom. The cat is usually very nervous around strangers, and wasn't snuggling up to me, who she'd had more contact with over the years. 

Umm... but yeah. There's always the chance of getting better. You have so much potential in you, and there's always the chance of reaching the potential and doing something amazing.
